title: Group data fields
summary: Scala: Group data fields. Make a copy with pages = 30.
introduction: A case class is a handy data type with named fields and value-based equality.

blocks.text: Install Scala CLI. Save each example as lesson.scala and run scala run lesson.scala. These examples use Scala 3 syntax.

blocks.title: Group data fields
blocks.code:
@main def lesson(): Unit =
  case class Book(title: String, pages: Int)
  val book = Book("Moon Trip", 24)
  println(book.pages)

blocks.text: The constructor places 24 in pages. Dot access reads that field.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: copy creates a new value rather than changing the old one.
